rv.q: It’s two and a half hours (including intermission) very well spent!
Babes With Blades’s interpretation of one of Shakespeare’s darkest plays is exciting and subversive.
This is an often arresting and uniquely fascinating production to open Babes With Blades’ 2022 season.
There is plenty of RICHARD III to enjoy.
Seeing her in this role is marvelous!

cn.t: Babes with Blades delivers an exciting, subversive take on Shakespeare's dark tale with an empowered cast of female and nonbinary actors, some with disabilities, bringing visceral honesty to Richard's ruthless climb to power.
